gen-gf-unkempt-gf-tuffy: Unkempt brings a rough, hand-made swagger, its crossbars and stems matching in weight. Tuffy follows in sans-serif, drawn like a pencil that never presses harder, and its widely parted s keeps the text easy to follow.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-varela: Varela is a friendly sans-serif with a wide-mouthed c and a t whose crossbar and stem share a width. Across a full paragraph, Varela stays easygoing while Unkempt, the loud heading, does all the shouting.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-varela-round:
Unkempt has gaps that stop its c from collapsing into an o.

Big and brief is where it earns its keep, while Varela Round supplies softly framed counters and wide-mouthed rounds underneath.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-varta: Varta opens every e and a into big, generous eyes, a plain sans that lets the heading talk. Unkempt's ruler-drawn line is the sharper voice.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-vazirmatn: Vazirmatn reads warm and open, its s never tightening up. Unkempt is best at bent-rope lines that grab attention, whereas Vazirmatn is best at carrying sentences along quietly in sans.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-wix-madefor-display: Wix Madefor Display has gently flared curve ends that stay apart, giving a tidy sans texture. And Unkempt, with its monoweight skeleton, takes the louder spot above it, so the page gets a shout and then a steady voice.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-wix-madefor-text: Open terminals make Wix Madefor Text easy going, a plain sans that never fights for attention. Wix Madefor Text lets Unkempt, with every stroke ending at one measured thickness, hold the spotlight above.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-ysabeau: Ysabeau reads smooth and approachable, with sweeping curves that never close up. Ysabeau, a plain sans, is the quiet foil to Unkempt's heavy-handed heading, whose curves meet stems without any swelling.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-ysabeau-infant: Approachable is the first word for Ysabeau Infant, a plain sans whose terminals point outward like a pair of tongs. Unkempt's ruler-straight lines sit above it.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-ysabeau-office: Modern in feel, Ysabeau Office keeps an open-ended look on every curved letter, a plain sans that never crowds itself. And across a full page its curves stay inviting, while Unkempt's constant-width pen line stays up in the heading.
